# Gabriela Caballero

> Technical AI Product Manager at Google, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Works on Context & Retrieval in Google AI Foundations: the retrieval and context systems that help Google's AI products find and ground answers in the right information.

"I make AI useful and understandable — building the retrieval systems that ground it, and telling the stories that help everyone benefit from it, not just the most technical."

5+ years at Google turning messy, unstructured data (video, images, spreadsheets and search indices) into products people use. Engineer from Argentina, Fulbright Scholar, and mentor to women and Latinas in tech.

## Experience

- Google, AI Foundations · Context & Retrieval — Product Manager, Zurich (Oct 2026–present).
- Google, YouTube Shopping — Product Manager, Zurich (Mar 2024–Oct 2026): Gemini-powered shopping assistant in YouTube's "Ask" feature; video understanding and product detection with Google DeepMind (+13% shoppable corpus); Gemini auto-timestamps; shopping on Connected TV; mobile product overlays.
- Google Sheets (Workspace) — Product Manager, London (Jul 2022–Mar 2024): co-led Tables in Google Sheets; Conditional Notifications.
- Google Maps — Associate Product Manager, New York (Jun 2021–Jul 2022): visual search from imagery; service-menu photos; India Language Picker (+12% regional monthly users). APM intern on Google Docs (2020).
- Earlier: NYU Furman Center data researcher (2021); Technical Lead at Globant for Disney Parks (2018–2019); Intel McAfee developer intern (2016–2017).

## Education and awards

- MS in Management of Technology and Innovation, New York University — Fulbright Scholar (1 of 10 from 500 candidates); NYU Research Innovation Award.
- BS in Systems Engineering, Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN-FRC), Córdoba, Argentina — Bicentennial Scholarship.

## Community

- Girls Who Code lead instructor and mentor (2018–present); Google APM interviewer and mentor; NYU Design for America.
